subject.title: feat(skills): add option to disable ~/.agents/skills scanning for Claude Code coexistence

question: Should OpenClaw expose a public config/API for disabling built-in skill source directories such as `agents-skills-personal`, and if so what shape should it take?
rationale: The issue is valid from source inspection, but the fix adds a new config surface and changes how shared personal skill directories participate in prompt/session construction.

options.title: Add source-level disable list
options.body: Expose a narrow `skills.load.disableSources` or equivalent enum list, keep current sources enabled by default, and document the upgrade behavior.

options.title: Add path ignore list
options.body: Expose a more flexible directory ignore list, accepting broader config complexity and path-resolution rules.

options.title: Keep current behavior
options.body: Decline the config surface and direct users to per-skill disabling or moving external skills out of the scanned convention path.

recommendation.title: Add source-level disable list
recommendation.body: Expose a narrow `skills.load.disableSources` or equivalent enum list, keep current sources enabled by default, and document the upgrade behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current `.agents/skills` source behavior and are the clearest history-backed routing candidate from the repository evidence.
